text:
olivia: Heads-up — enterprise tenant reported confusion: their admins can't see which routing policy was used when requests hit quota fallbacks. UX shows 'default route' but not the fallback chain. :eyes:
dan: Ugh. That explains several support tickets. We currently hide fallback details unless you have org-admin. Is that intentional?
sara: It used to be hidden because fallback routes may reference internal-only models and we'd leak info. But we can show an abstracted view (e.g., 'fallback to compatible variant') without model names.
leo: Can we instead gate the visibility by a new boolean in the role: "show_routing_debug"? That way tenant-admins can opt-in via enterprise contract.
matt: I worry about proliferation of feature flags on roles. Also product asked to avoid toggles per tenant if possible. Maybe a scoped permission `routes:inspect` scoped to route or tenant?
jia: From telemetry side: we already record the chosen route id and fallback chain in request traces. We can expose a read-only column in the Console that shows "effective route id" and a tooltip with sanitized chain. Audit logs will include full details for org-admins.
olivia: Proposed compromise: add `routes:inspect` permission that is default-off for tenant-admin role; customer success can enable per-contract. In the Console UI show: "Effective route: <human friendly name>" for users with permission, otherwise show "Effective route: hidden (request support)".
dan: Sounds reasonable. Two follow-ups: 1) quota implications — if a request was routed to lower tier due to quota, we should show that flag in the audit row. 2) telemetry: include a hash of the fallback chain so we can correlate without exposing model names.
sara: For 1) we already have quota_reason in the runtime event; we can map that to a small badge on the row: `quota-throttle` or `quota-burst`. UX: compact badge next to latency/cost.
leo: UX question — where does this live? Route table? Request detail drawer? Both?
matt: Minimal: add to request detail drawer + column on recent requests table (condensed). Avoid bloating route list.
jia: Will add a field `fallback_chain_hash` and `effective_route_display` to the request telemetry event. I'll emit both to eventstream v2.
infra-bot: deployment triggered by @matt for feature-flag backend changes (deploy/573)
olivia: Implementation tasks assigned: matt -> API & role permission `routes:inspect` (backend + authz checks). jia -> telemetry fields + docs. sara -> console UI: drawer + requests table badge. dan -> support playbook update. leo -> small design copy for sanitized tooltip. I'll draft PR checklist.
dan: One more edge: we need migration for existing tokens — they should inherit old behavior (hidden). So default should be false.
matt: Agreed. Also add an internal audit-only endpoint so CS can retrieve full fallback chain for triage (requires org-admin).
sara: Mockups incoming in ~24h. I'll try to keep it compact.
jia: ETA: telemetry change + schema bump next week; will gate in runtime behind feature flag.
olivia: Thanks all — this will reduce CS tickets. Filing a short RFC and linking here. :thumbsup:"
